name: n8n Form Trigger (PR #7130)
notes: front_door.url_template's {webhook_id} is the webhookId UUID minted into workflow.json's Form Trigger node — the node's webhookId IS the URL base (n8n 1.12 has no /form/ endpoint; the form serves at /webhook/<webhookId>/n8n-form). The runner reads that webhookId out of workflow.json and substitutes it for {webhook_id}. code_identity: the merge SHA 3ddc176d self-reports version 1.11.0 (version_label); the first shipped release containing #7130 is 1.12.0 (use mode:pinned_image with image_ref docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n:1.12.0 for the label-clean path).

front_door.serves: the server-rendered Form Trigger page (GET) and the multipart form submit (POST -> {status:200})

queries.executions: SELECT id, workflowId, status, finished FROM execution_entity ORDER BY id;
